attempts.summary: On node1 (RHEL 9.8), created unprivileged user appsvc, installed podman, and deployed a rootless nginx:alpine container as a Podman Quadlet systemd user service (webapp.service) publishing port 8080. Enabled loginctl linger for appsvc so its systemd user manager and the container start at boot without any active login session. Verified HTTP 200 on both 127.0.0.1:8080 and $NODE_IP:8080. Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id and healthy state, rebooted node1 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed (5f3ce3b8... -> 0fd74c0c...), and verified the container service auto-recovered post-boot with zero login sessions, HTTP 200 responses restored, and the container process owned by appsvc (uid 1000).
